description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService component of the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee immigration records, utilizing mock objects and fixtures.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmployeeImmigrationRecordService methods related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService instance and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of employee immigration records for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific employee immigration record by employee and record IDs.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests saving (creating/updating) an employee immigration record.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee immigration records for a specific employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests searching employee immigration records with filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee immigration records matching specific search filters.
